title: xsa workspace
description: Several projects (React/Next.js/TS and Java/Spring Boot) analyzed together, linked through their API definitions.

name.description: Unique short name; prefixes node ids (name::file#fn)

root.description: Path to the project, relative to this file

hosts.description: Host names / base URLs that identify this project as a call target, e.g. users-service, api.example.com/v1, localhost:8081

openapi.description: OpenAPI documents of this project (default: discovered)
Extra OpenAPI documents or directories shared by all projects (e.g. a contracts repo)
